# HagiCode Gallery

> Browse images from HagiCode's img-gen pipeline. Every image shows its prompts, seed and generation details.

## Overview

- [HagiCode Gallery](https://gallery.hagicode.com/): Browse images from HagiCode's img-gen pipeline. Every image shows its prompts, seed and generation details.

## Albums

- [Agent CLI default cats](https://gallery.hagicode.com/albums/agent-cli-default-cats/): Default cat avatars for agent CLI sessions. 1 image
- [Cat head gallery](https://gallery.hagicode.com/albums/cat-head-gallery/): Cat head portraits. 1,000 images
- [DeepSeek whale girl gallery](https://gallery.hagicode.com/albums/deepseek-whale-girl-gallery/): The whale-maid character drawn in many styles, proportions and scenes. 1,000 images
- [Hero avatars](https://gallery.hagicode.com/albums/hero-avatars/): Avatar portraits for the hero section. 720 images
- [Planning direction icons](https://gallery.hagicode.com/albums/planning-direction-icons/): Emblem icons for the proposal planning directions. 8 images
- [Prompt scenario covers](https://gallery.hagicode.com/albums/prompt-scenario-covers/): Cover images for prompt scenarios. 14 images
- [Scenario stage backgrounds](https://gallery.hagicode.com/albums/scenario-stage-backgrounds/): Background images for scenario stages and tasks. 27 images
- [Startup splash](https://gallery.hagicode.com/albums/startup-splash/): Images shown while the app starts. 600 images
- [TokenMonitor stage illustrations](https://gallery.hagicode.com/albums/tokenmonitor-stage-illustrations/): Stage illustrations for TokenMonitor. 15 images
